tasks.title: Create the electron-vite project structure with main, preload, renderer and shared entry points
tasks.dod: npm run build succeeds; the app boots on macOS and shows an empty React window; renderer runs with contextIsolation, sandbox and no nodeIntegration; src/shared has no Electron or DOM imports

tasks.title: Wire the test harness: Vitest (node + jsdom with Testing Library) and a Playwright Electron boot smoke test
tasks.dod: npm test runs green with one trivial shared-module test; npm run test:e2e launches the built app via Playwright _electron and asserts the main window opens

tasks.title: Add the typed IPC contract and preload bridge (one ping channel end to end)
tasks.dod: src/shared/ipc.ts defines channel names and payload types; main registers handlers in src/main/ipc.ts; window.api.ping() round-trips in the running app; types flow to the renderer without any hand-written channel strings

tasks.title: Set up the versioned JSON store with atomic writes and a schemaVersion migration runner
tasks.dod: the store reads and writes settings.json in a configurable directory atomically (temp + rename); an initial v1 schema and an empty migration chain load and upgrade cleanly; unit tests cover a fresh file, an existing v1 file and a corrupt file

tasks.title: Add design tokens, the CSS Modules convention and Motion to the renderer
tasks.dod: tokens.css defines color (light and dark), spacing, radius, typography and motion custom properties; one placeholder component styled with a *.module.css file uses tokens and a Motion animation that honors prefers-reduced-motion; build stays green

tasks.title: Configure ESLint (flat, typescript-eslint), Prettier and the typecheck script
tasks.dod: npm run lint and npm run typecheck both pass on the skeleton

tasks.title: Configure electron-builder to produce an unsigned macOS .dmg
tasks.dod: npm run dist:mac produces a .dmg that installs and launches (via Open Anyway); signing and notarization are explicitly disabled in config

tasks.title: Add the GitHub Actions CI workflow on macos-latest
tasks.dod: the workflow is valid and runs npm ci, typecheck, lint, test and build; its commands match package.json scripts

tasks.title: Write CLAUDE.md from the foundation conventions
tasks.dod: CLAUDE.md states the commands, the process boundary, timer-truth in main, IPC contract, store and migration rules, and UI token and styling rules, consistent with docs/architecture-map.md
